7607.overview:
Less of a workout and more of a party, the Zumba Fitness craze has helped millions of people shed unwanted weight through invigorating high-calorie-burning workouts. Now you can harness the benefits of Zumba right at home with this interactive exercise program. The one-of-a-kind Zumba model is based on easy-to-follow dance moves blended with addictive Latin and World Music rhythms.

Sculpt your body and burn excess fat with 30 routines designed and guided by Zumba creator Beto and an array of renowned Zumba instructors. Multiple skill levels help you learn the steps, then find more challenges as you go. The more precise your movements, the more electric the atmosphere gets.

10636.overview: Players can learn and perfect nine different dance styles: Reggaeton, Merengue, Salsa, Cumbia, Hip hop, Mambo, Rumba, Flamenco and Calypso as well as new routines including the Axe, Indian, Latin Pop, Bellydance and Pasodoble., led by Zumba creator Beto and celebrity instructors Gina Grant and Tanya Beardsley. New features include a calorie tracker, revamped gameplay, and graphical representations of the instructors.

12521.overview:
Zone of the Enders HD Collection includes remastered versions of:

•    Zone of the Enders
•    Zone of the Enders: The 2nd Runner

Retail copies of the game also include a playable demo of Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance.

13428.overview: Rock your core and dance your way to toned, sexy abs with Zumba Fitness Core, featuring 40 new songs and routines, more than 30 international dance styles from around the world and hot new choreography that's designed to sculpt stronger abs through an exhilarating full body workout. Lose yourself in the music as celebrity Zumba instructors guide you through choreography set to contagious new Zumba fitness originals and a broader mix of smash hits from hot artists including Enrique Iglesias and Don Omar (full soundtrack to be announced at a future date).

14376.overview:
Zoids Assault is the re-imagining of the Zoids universe based on the toy model franchise. It is a strategy game with RPG elements that features giant robots. The player takes charge of Maroll's 99th Zoid Platoon, Mace Squad, and leads a covert mission behind enemy lines into Jamil alongside Sgt. Jessica Lambert and the commando squad known as Katana. The zoids can be customized with parts claimed from defeated foes to build up a force that can get a stronger grip on the battlefield.

Since story's setting places the player working behind enemy lines, he is constantly outgunned and outmanned at nearly every turn. The player controls a squad of five zoid pilots that have a different role in the squad. They need to be managed in terms of special skills, weapon/armor loadout, and can be customized with different color schemes.

Because of the long odds facing the mission, mastering cover fire, coordinated fire, and the EMP systems will be the key to leading Mace Squad to victory, with the aim to bring the shadows of a 10-year-old conflict to the light of day.

17317.overview:
An irresistible force has taken our fearless frog to an island where the ribbeting puzzle-action of Zuma has evolved in amazing ways... but evil spirits and tenacious tiki bosses rule the land! 

Survive the ire of the island by firing stone spheres to destroy the deadly stream of balls. Conquer over 60 levels by staying sharp and avoiding hidden traps. Slide and hop for smarter shots; hit targets for exotic bonuses; detonate new power-up balls; battle six imposing tiki bosses and guide your agile amphibian to victory in four all new game modes! Will you succumb to the perilous pitfalls, or can you tame the jungle in this PopCap ball-blasting challenge? 

Includes two full bonus Pop Cap games - Bejeweled 3 and Feeding Frenzy 2!

34724.overview:
Jump in and have a blast with Zumba Kids, the ultimate dance-fitness party that gets families moving together with fun, high-energy rhythms across 20 different dance styles!

First video game based on the Zumba dance-fitness program designed specifically for Kids
Encourages self-confidence and fitness, and enhances coordination
Teaches you 20+ international dance styles across 30 easy-to-follow routines
Party with up to 4 players; Move to hit music from Justin Bieber, Willow Smith and more!

164294.overview: In the land of Zenozoik, the city of Halstedom is ruled by a powerful clan, one which Ghat has betrayed by killing Father-Mother, the clan's leader. As Ghat, you'll have to face your brothers and sisters, insane anarchists, and other enemies, in order to escape in this unique first-person puncher. The bare-knuckled brawl to reach the truth has just begun.

164295.overview:
The world as you know it is gone. A zombie infection has swept the globe and the undead now outnumber the living, but you have plenty of ammo and it's time for payback! 

Destroy as many zombies as you can and try to save any remaining survivors as you blast your way through seven danger filled environments. Up to four players can battle the zombie hordes with an arsenal of eleven deadly weapons, including mini-guns, flame throwers, grenade launchers, and a chainsaw for when it's time to get in close... or save on ammo by forcing zombies into the whirling blades of a helicopter or the spinning teeth of a wood chipper. Unlock seven challenging game modes as hone your zombie killing skills and protect the world from a Zombie Apocalypse!

164296.overview: Vibrantly colored stones spiral relentlessly toward the gaping jaws of a cursed gold skull. Fire stones from the frog idol’s mouth to create a chain of three or more like-colored stones and make the string disappear. Clear the temple of all the stones before they are devoured. Some balls send the stones rolling backwards, others slow the pace, and still others help guide your aim. Coins, combos, gap shots and Ace Times can earn you bonus points. Advance through the 13 increasingly difficult levels in Adventure mode. Success there unlocks additional levels in Gauntlet mode, where the stones never stop coming, and you must stay alive as long as you can.

173712.overview:
Zoo Tycoon is an entry in Microsoft's long-running zoo management series and the first game in the series for a console platform. In the Challenge mode the player has to build a zoo from the ground up with short challenges. This includes designing the environment, building exhibits with important parts such as feeders, bathing stations and various enrichments, taking care of the animals, managing finances and keeping an eye on the visitors' happiness. The game uses a top-down mode for the overall management, a third-person mode to explore the zoo on foot or using a buggie, and a first-person perspective for some activities and taking photographs while exploring, similar to the earlier Kinect: Disneyland Adventures by the same developer. The overall performance is tracked through different status bars with three main colours: red, orange and green. The other game modes next to the Challenge mode are Training mode (ten missions), Freeform mode (no pressure for money or research) and Campaign mode (twenty levels with long-term goals). Up to four players can work together simultaneously in the three main modes to build and maintain the zoo with support for voice chat.

By doing well experience is gained to level up (zoo fame) and access new possibilities. Many animals and structures need to be researched before they are used (only one at a time) and then they can be used in the zoo. Paths are designed automatically in a logical manner after placing buildings and cannot be edited. Animals include antelopes, bears, binturongs, elephants, flamingoes, fossas, giraffes, hippopotamuses, komodo dragons, iguanas, lemurs, lions, lizards, macaws, meerkats, mongooses, monkeys, pandas, peafowls, rhinos, sloths, snakes, tigers and tortoises. There are multiple varieties of a single species. The Xbox 360 version contains about 65 animals and the Xbox One version over 100. Information about each type of animal is stored in the Zoopedia. All adoptable animals have a level between two and fifteen. Once they reach the highest level, players can choose to release them into the wild. Buildings have levels as well (up to three), for instance allowing you to hire more staff and providing upgrades.

The game supports Kinect for some activities tied to specific animals. A hose can be used to wash animals, you can pick up fruit to feed them, and baby chimps or lions will attempt to mimic your facial expressions. Voice commands are also supported.

181848.overview:
Zombie Wranglers is a fast-paced action co-op game that pits four zombie wrangling youths against hordes of undead that threaten the city of Potters Field. The kids of Wrangler Union 138 take the fight to the streets, travel through the suburbs, local summer camp, and the local strip mall. Played from a third-person perspective in a world with cartoony, cell shaded graphics, the kids run around to fight Emo, Skater, and Mailman zombies using weaponry such as glue bombs, shrink grenades and zombie repellent headgear. Their most important tool is always at their disposal, the Wrangler pack. Turning undead into raw essence is rewarded with cash.

Most of the 20 missions have a number of chores that need to be performed – destroying specific monsters, and locating or destroying items and structures.

201384.overview:
Zombie Driver HD is an enhanced re-release of the Windows game Zombie Driver and also incorporates the DLC Zombie Driver: Summer of Slaughter. For the other platforms this is the first release of the game. It is a top-down racing shooter set in a city where most of the residents are turned into zombies following a chemical explosion. The player is one of the few unscathed people who manages to escape and as he is chased by the zombies, he jumps into a cab and flees. In the Story mode 31 missions need to be completed driving the cab outfitted with weapons in a free-roaming environment.

About one eighth of the Story mode has been reworked with new missions. They involve defending areas against waves of zombies, transporting cargo, rescuing survivors against a time limit, spraying anti-zombie repellent around the town, and boss fights. The two new modes for this edition are Blood Race and Slaughter. Blood Race consists of 30 events based around three game types: Race (classic races), Eliminator (take down vehicles with a time limit), and Endurance (a bomb race where checkpoints extend the detonation limit). The Slaughter mode is a survival game type with 7 arenas and a dynamic upgrade system.

There are 13 types of vehicles (9 more than the original game—including a bulldozer, a firetruck and a tank) and 9 upgrades in total. Other novelties for this edition are in-game cutscenes for the story, a minimap and an overview map, 3 additional types of enemies, a rechargeable nitro system to burn zombies, improved performance, and more realistic weather, fire, smoke and explosion effects.

203893.overview: Zumba Fitness World Party is a home workout game that helps players burn up to 1,000 calories per hour as you immerse yourself in the movement and music of exotic global destinations.

210008.overview: Travel through time to co-op play with a copy of yourself! Pull off amazing moves to defeat 8 massive bosses! Pace the game and improve your score with the powerful fast forward feature! Discover 6 unique game modes and beat 70 challenges in this innovative and action packed arcade game!

420213.overview: Zoids Infinity EX Neo is a port of the arcade game Zoids Infinity. In this expanded version of the game, players could play against each other online through Xbox Live.

420214.overview: Zegapain XOR is an Action game, developed by Cavia Inc. and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2006. The game is similar in nature to Zone of the Enders. A mech action game, the player controls Cerebrant Toga Vital and the plot runs parallel to the events of the anime. Zegapain XOR is set on the Oceanus-class ship Dvaraka and commanded by Isola, a recurring character in the anime series. Several characters who appear in the game make brief appearances in the anime series.

420224.overview: Zegapain NOT is a sequel and companion to Zegapain XOR and continues the storyline of the previous game. The game features a special online mode that allows for cross-disc online play, enabling players with Zegapain XOR to play against players with Zegapain NOT. The game has over 3,000 ways to customize your character.

422822.overview: Ghat's story is far from over: Zeno Clash 2 picks up where the deliciously brazen first game left off. After 4 years of waiting, the sequel to ACE Team’s surreal first-person brawler brings more variety in combat and levels, stunning upgraded visuals, and even more bizarre storytelling into the beguiling stonepunk world of Zenozoik. Zeno Clash 2 welcomes new players to the Zeno Clash universe with a new game that will introduce them to the world and fill them in on the backstory. Returning players will delight in the connections between the Ghat’s and Rimat’s new quest and their past adventures. All players will thoroughly enjoy playing a first-person brawler that provides a rarity in modern gaming: a truly unique experience.

423027.overview: Four unlikely heroes find themselves caught in a fight for their lives when the Zombie Apocalypse hits their Canadian community. Banding together for both humor and survival - and armed with everything from guns to cricket bats - the four must find a way off the island... together.

440173.overview:
Zombie Estate is a twin-stick shooter with pixel graphics. The player, as one of 30 characters, is alone (or together with up to three other players) in an abandoned estate which is overrun with zombies. The goal is to fight off all 25 waves without dying a horrible death. In later waves the zombie don't only become more numerous but also bring friends like the healing priest or the skeleton.

The movement of the player character is controlled with one stick while the other is used to aim the equipped weapon. While the standard pistol has unlimited ammo, additional weapons and their ammo can be bought between rounds at the shop. The needed money is received after finishing a wave or dropped by killed enemies.

466607.overview: The Year is 3030 and you are a glorified futuristic forklift driver, in space. It's a perilous job, with low safety standards and ridiculously high risk but the money is good and training is optional. You've just landed a contract and your boss doesn't hold you in high regard; your not even sure if your Lifter is air tight. The decent of your life, is really up to you. A huge 3D space simulation.

468148.overview: From the creators of "Rumble Massage": Brave the memorizing world of ZOOM as you push the boundaries of speed. Race through a mind numbing 3D landscape in 5 unique hoverships to gauge just how much speed you can handle.

479538.overview:
Zippy's on the loose!

Help Zippy escape nefarious waves of cyborg experiments run loose from the research lab. Use magnet powers to launch across levels! Repel enemies and dodge projectiles! Defeat the evil cyborg sea cucumber, Wopley!

Excitement and more! Zippy goes above and beyond the call!

479539.overview: An aether packet recieved on your TransVidia starts you on your quest. Explore a MegaCity and hak your way to fortune and adventure in this futuristic RPG.

479540.overview:
In the middle of the zombie apocalypse, danger lurks around every corner and nobody can be trusted.

Will you survive despite the odds being stacked against you? Will you help others or selfishly go it alone?

Decide your fate in Zombie Adventure. Combines text adventures with old school RPG's.

479547.overview: A 2 player cooperative Isometric game. Play as the exiled vampire queen Zandri and her faithful adviser Melar, as they try to retake Zandri's queendom from the evil king Orond.

479554.overview:
Effortlessly create beautiful music with this intuitive musical instrument/toy.

Great for all ages.

479557.overview: Tower defence with zombies and sniping first person.

479558.overview: Stop the zombie hoard from escaping with your car.

479559.overview:
Help Special Forces operative Della retrieve the Bio-waste containers that are causing the zombie outbreak and evacuate in the helicopter.

Explore the island and find Bio-waste containers and neutralise enough Zombies to achieve the Zombie Death Quota.

Scavenge for guns, ammo, grenades and health packs scattered around the island to help you in your mission.

479566.overview: Zombies have overrun the city(again!). As a sniper for the US army, your mission is to contain the zombie threat before it becomes a brain-fest. Expect hours of heart-pounding, zombie-shooting fun, with realistic sniping action, and 3 game modes to choose from!

479571.overview: Zatacka 360 is a remake of the classic multiplayer DOS game in which players must steer their curves away from one another in order to survive. Players can gain the upper hand by trapping their opponents or using powerups . The classic game has been expanded with five crazy powerups and additional game modes, all in full HD and features an original soundtrack

479577.overview: Nothing is cooler than non-stop zombie killing action with strategy. Introducing Smart Arrows and Ropes for the awesome adventurous action. Annihilate the zombie masses by the cool power arrows like Electric, Whirlwind or Tornadoes.

479582.overview: GHOST DOGS, DUBSTEP, SPLIT SCREEN CO-OP ZOMBIE KILLING FUN.

479585.overview:
Reach your inner Om with Zens 360. Start each day off with a short, thoughtful zen.

Includes 100 unique zens from Buddha to Yasutani Roshi.

479590.overview: Introducing Zombie Armageddon, a new tower defense game combining innovative gameplay and a cinematic "boy meets zombies" storyline. Zombie Armageddon engages players with 11 progressive levels of zombie mayhem, plus an unlimited "Onslaught" mode to tax players' defensive strategies and intestinal fortitude.

479591.overview: Zombie Block Planet is an survival horror game in a block based environment. Enter a world of creation, construction, exploration, adventure and survival. Fight off the zombie madness. Blast the zombies before they eat your brains! Explore and battle enemies to earn coins.

479593.overview: Hey, dude. There are some aliens. I guess you should shoot them. This game is pretty short and fast paced. New enemy types are introduced constantly, and the bosses change up the rules, so stay on your toes! AND you can play with a friend!

479594.overview: Guess what zombies can teach? Featuring three courses Giddy Up, Leap N Roll and Flip N Dive.

479596.overview: Nothing is certain but the UNDEAD and taxes! Don't eat your coworkers - there's accounting to be done!

479597.overview:
Zombies, Arrows, Special Powers and Shields!

Featuring Campaign and Survival modes of challenging and nonstop zombie killing action.

479601.overview: The zombies now have a taste for milk! See if you can milk more than your friends in this frantic fun-filled party game! Who will be the champion?

479602.overview: Arcade style twin stick zombie shooter. Survive wave after wave of zombie mobs, purchase and upgrade weapons/character in between in each wave!

479603.overview: Mike hears that there is something fishy going on in the military base he once operated on. Taking his daughter with him they go to investigate to find that all the soldiers are dead. Survive with Mike and Alice in this epic shooter and go down in history as the saviours of mankind!

479613.overview:
You are the only hope for humanity. You are the Zombie Hunter. You've fought countless zombies and tracked them to where they have originated from.

Can you defeat the zombies roaming the city, and destroy the five buildings they are emerging from to finally put an end to their terror?

Purchase weapons, ammo and health from the store. Kill zombies to collect dynamite and power-ups.

479614.overview: Zombie Monkeys takes your classic tower defense game into the heart of the jungle. Maya Zombies have risen from the grave and the desire for monkey brains has them on the move. Defend your temple with single target blow gun towers, splash damage coconut towers, slowing banana towers, dazing pineapple towers and more. Do you have what it takes to defend your temple from brain sucking zombies?

479615.overview:
The exciting, yet smaller by 1 dimension, prequel to Zombie Hunter. You are given the task of saving as many survivors as possible while defending yourself from the hordes of zombies that have infested the catacombs.

Can you end their zombie terror? If so, a surprise awaits you at the end...

479616.overview: Join the Zombie Defense Squad and help protect the city from the growing zombie menace. Earn cash by clearing zombies and use this cash to purchase new weapons and ammo. You can play offline or choose to go online and play co-op with three other people in this fast paced zombie shooter.

479617.overview: Shoot & knife your way through endless levels of zombies and rescue as many survivors as you can. Get money for each zombie kill and for each survivor saved. Get as much money as you can since reloading is expensive. Get pickup items to boost your power, but be warned, the zombies get stronger also. First Person Zombie Killing Action.

479618.overview: Zombies have run-a-muck in a medieval village. Your job is to collect the body parts of the fallen villagers. You must avoid the zombies at all costs, or... find an axe and chop them to bits.

479619.overview: Monsters! Monsters everywhere! Fight your way through endless waves of baddies decided to rip you apart. Upgrade your gear in the shop and use more than 15 weapons at your disposal to score a bloody touchdown!

479620.overview: Eat your way to the top in this button-mashing, man-chasing, brain-eating frolic through the streets of Zombieopolis.

479621.overview:
The world has been plagued by the Z-Virus. This zombifying virus brings a terrible death by infecting the host's lower extremities on up. Then it possesses the corpse. This newly zombified corpse will continue the cycle by infecting more innocent people.

Your job is to retrieve the legendary N-Antivirus from the Dungeon of Doom. The question becomes, do you have the guts to make it out alive?

479622.overview:
Fight off the zombie madness. Blast the zombies before they eat your brains!

You are stuck alone in the middle of a city with a lot of zombies. Crowds of hungry zombies are eager to eat you alive. Shoot them as fast as you can, develop better skills and get the hell out of there!

479623.overview:
Survive and make it to the other end of the city with your M9 & AK. You wish dayz like these didn't exist, with no where to hide, your ears and your eyes are the only first aid.

Warning, gore and blood from an excessive number of zombies.

479624.overview:
Zombie Death Zone is a twin-stick shooter with zombies. After a zombie infestation, clones are sent into the zone to deal with them. The problem: each clone only has a lifespan of 60 seconds.

The basic goal is to accumulate as many points as possible during this short time. The player is directly after starting the game overwhelmed by a lot of zombies from all directions and the only option is to shoot. In fact, the game automatically shoots and the player only controls the movement and aim direction. While the standard rifle does not have too much impact with the zombie masses, there are a number of secondary weapons available: uzi, flamethrower, minigun and a nuke. All of them (except the nuke which just clears everything out) last a few seconds and are activated in the listed order.

Besides zombies there are a few other items littered around the battlefield: explosive barrels, nuke symbols (collecting three of them has the same effect as the nuke weapon) and, most importantly, energy cells. Collecting six of the latter grants another 60 seconds of life which comes with new set of weapons.

479625.overview:
Experience the terror of being trapped in the Zombie Outhouse as you try to defend yourself for as long as possible. Play through 25 levels acquiring 5 different weapons to help you survive.

Also includes Endless mode where you have immediate access to all available weapons.

479626.overview: Join the Zombie Defense Squad and help protect the town from the zombie menace. Earn cash by eradicating zombies and use this cash to purchase new weapons and ammo. You can play offline or choose to go online and play co-op with three other people in this fast paced zombie shooter.

479627.overview:
Continue from wave to wave using millions of upgrades to these guns at your disposal ending swarms of zombie' lives!

If you every feel overwhelmed; just hire Tim! Tim the Gunsman will rebuild barriers for you to keep you safe!

Just don't have too many close calls or you may have to hire Tim's lesser brother Tim instead...

479628.overview:
How long can you survive in this co-op wave based shooter?

Featuring 35 characters with unique stats, over 100 weapons, 30 stat-boosting hats, and 6 unique levels, Zombie Estate 2 is a frantically fun experience to share with friends!

Where else could you be a duck wielding a shotgun or a robot with his favorite flame thrower?

479629.overview: Poker anyone? A good hand such as a Full House gets you powerful towers. You better hope that you have the towers you need placed in strategic locations. The waves of Zombies have no mercy! And just when you think you are good, the boss will show up to challenge you your dominion. This game is non-stop fun.

479630.overview:
Up to 4 player, twin stick shooter. How long can you survive against wave after wave of Zombies...?

Who's the sharpest shooter! Who's got what it takes to get the high score!

479645.overview: So, you think you know everything about zombies? Well, you haven't seen 'Zombie Sausages', did you? There is nowhere you can hide, these sausages are trying to take over the world. Only you can save the world from this horror! You have to act fast and shoot them all....

479646.overview: The zombie sausages are back! Including a brand new two player mode. There is nowhere you can hide, these sausages are trying to take over the world.

479647.overview:
Defend the town from endless hordes of zombies with up to 4 of your friends.

Purchase weapons, utilize vehicles and survive for as long as you can.

479649.overview: Take on the best Zombie Racers in this automotive zombie bloodfest.•Story Mode: race and kill zombies, use zombie kills to upgrade your car, come first to unlock the next track.•Free Roaming Mode: go anywhere, use weapons on zombies and each other, compete in three new game modes, Dusk To Dawn, 666 Zombies and Every Last Drop. •Unlock new cars and tracks.•10 cars, from pickups and monster 4x4s to drift cars and even a golf cart.•14 tracks, from a forest and a cornfield to an airport and shopping mall.•Punk soundtrack from Bankrupt.•OpenFeint achievements and high scores.

479650.overview:
Jake gets his buddy Dean to help him work a security job at a stripper convention. Unfortunately for Dean, this happens to be ground zero for the zombie apocalypse.

Play as former marine Dean as he and his buddy Jake attempt to gather supplies and find a way out before being eaten alive by zombie strippers.

Features weapon unlocks, multiple zombie types, and 20 levels to progress through.

479651.overview: Driven mad after losing his farm to foreclosure, local turkey farmer J. Snydles plots his revenge on an unsuspecting town. Using steroids, toxic waste, and a small amount of energy drink, Snydles concocts a brew that turns his turkeys into mindless minions. On the brink of panic, returning war hero Bret Star must save his town before it's too late. Zombie Turkeys Must Die!!

479652.overview:
This is the story of how the best day of your life can become a nightmare full of zombies.

Survive in a hostile environment using all sorts of weapons. Defend your position with barricades, blow up groups of zombies with grenades, sweep the area away with a Gatling and more! All in a fully action packed game with colorful backgrounds and fearsome monsters.

Show us that you're more than a snack for zombies!

479653.overview:
Most zombie games are about survival. Not this one. These zombies are hungry but they're not stupid and will try to escape. Your job is to stop that. Cruelty is rewarded. Mercy is punished.

Play by yourself or with a friend to see who is the meanest zombie killer!

479654.overview: Run and gun zombies in this frantic 4 player racing game. Recharge you nitro boost by slaying zombies to finish first on 8 insane tracks!

479655.overview:
You use to be safe atop your precious little trees, but now you have been knocked down and must use the resources of the jungle to fend off your fiendish brain eating foes. Beware for other tribes have fallen to this disease and some have unexpected qualities.

You can brave this journey alone or recruit some of your old friends, the choice is yours.

Hurry, you must defend the temple.

479656.overview: This is a deck building card game where you and your friends are fighting for survival. Zombie have come to your town and are out to get you. Use your luck to buy action cards like guns and duct tape, or buy survival cards like food and water. At the end of the game the player with the most survival points wins.

479657.overview: Alice returns in this action packed sequel to continue her fight for survival! Battle through all new environments, fight new types of zombie and take on new quests to advance the plot. Survival horror has never been so real!

479658.overview:
Zombies. Lots of Guns.

Did I mention Zombies?

479659.overview: See how long you can survive against the zombie apocalypse. Use all of the resource available in the town square to fight off the horde.

479661.overview: Evil has risen, and only two elite soldiers have what it takes to send it back to hell! Featuring: - Almost a dozen intensifying levels, across 4 environments, adding up to hours of nail-biting gameplay - Rich graphics and a killer soundtrack - Strategic use of weapons in order to complete your mission - Learn your enemies weaknesses, and use the environment to your advantage!

479662.overview: Zombies 2.0 is a small 2.5D defend the base game with real-time lighting and persistent blood effects. You play as a defense robot tasked with protecting the Science Team from an incoming zombie horde. Use cash earnt from kills to purchase more powerful and devastating weapons and upgrade your base with potent defences. Play round based mode or test your skills against the brutal survival mode.

479663.overview:
Zombies are under attack - by aliens! But what's a poor zombie to do against a menace that can teleport, cloak, bomb and otherwise outmaneuver them?

Join in the mayhem and help the zombies protect their precious brain bank from alien obliteration!

479664.overview: Kill the zombies before they enter the building and eat your brains! Enabled by the Torque X 3D Engine Zombie Sniper 3D provides unparalleled graphics rendering and appearance, with advanced shading and dynamic lighting effects. Zombie Sniper 3D has a unique 4 track music mix that keeps the heart pumping. Zombie Sniper 3D also includes medals that can be earned during game play.

479665.overview: Official Dream Build Play 2010 entry. A fast paced arcade style shooter. Play one of three modes: Arcade, Story, and Challenge Mode. Kill as many zombies as you can, chaining combo shots together for bonus points! Protect civilians to complete your mission. Purchase the game to unlock the Challenge Mode!

479666.overview: Test your reaction and kill evil snowmen before they kill you. Press the buttons that appear at the screen and survive as long as you can. But be careful, they are getting faster and faster.

479667.overview: RPG meets zombie apocalypse in this action packed 2D retro styled adventure. Play as Alice, a young woman with a huge shotgun and a green bikini. Blast zombies away, find collectables to exchange, carry out dangerous missions to advance the plot and try to escape the massacre. Good Luck!

479668.overview: Annihilate hordes of undead weirdos, scavenge for supplies, rescue survivors, search for your lost friend and thwart an evil genius. All in a days work for Alice as she returns to exact another Zombie Shotgun Massacre!

479673.overview:
It's a trilogy! Zomp is back, many, many years later (don't do the math, please!) for a 3rd episode. This time, it's in HD!

Zomp 3: The Quest for Z's is a puzzle adventure game that will challenge more than 10% of your brain, guaranteed! Try to collect all the Z's on the map while avoiding certain death. Enemies will stand in your way, push you around, trap you, and kill you if you're not careful.

Follow Zomp through his dreams on many different themed levels: forest, ice, desert, underwater, space, lava, and caves.

479675.overview: Zulu Hour is a top down shooter that's reminiscent of the classic genre, but contains modern graphics and gameplay. Defend the planet in Campaign Mode or challenge a friend in Arcade Mode and see who can stay alive the longest! Build up your arsenal - you're going to need it.

479676.overview: ZP2K9 is a super-crazy multiplayer sidescroller. Play Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag and King of the Hill with 13 devastating weapons and 6 grenade types including Akimbo SMGs, the freeze gun, gas grenades, and the enemy-splattering MIRV.

479677.overview: Pterodactyls want blood! In a dystopian future where humans love guns and zombies just want to be left alone, the pterodactyls have seen to it that everyone has to be miserable together. Take your jetpack online and splatter some fools with blades, guns, grenades, and other instruments of mayhem. Earn XP, level up, unlock stuff, and build killer classes!

479678.overview: Zombies are everywhere! You are already dead, you know it, but before it happens you can use your shotgun to send them back to hell.

479679.overview: Zombusters is a fun and action-packed 3rd person game that will let you sticked on your seat until the end. Its 2D graphics and isometric view make it a different specie in its genre. You will have to face a horde of Zombies that try to get you down with the help of various weapons/power ups and differents moving styles.

479681.overview:
In the post-zombacalyptic times, the dark city is ruled by zombies. Few survivors who got stranded in the last two towers are looking for help.

Batter the zombies to death or gun them down in this realistic survival adventure.

Will you stand against these mutated zombies?

479682.overview: Uh-oh!! Humanity is in trouble now. Zombies have evolved. They've realized that brains taste like, well, brains and they're now after your favorite calorie laden snacks instead. It's up to you to stop them -- blast them, fry them, burn them, launch them off the kitchen table. Whatever you do, KEEP THOSE DAMN DIRTY ZOMBIE HANDS OFF YOUR COOKIEZ!!!

479684.overview:
Mutated Zombies everywhere!!! The experimental drug went awry and started spinning out new breed of zombies.

As the lone commander on ground, help the few stranded scientists to get airlifted.

Zomination is a twin-stick arcade style zombie shooter.

This game features five (5) different customizable weapons and cooperative gameplay.

479791.overview:
You are man's last hope in a total zombie invasion. See if you have what it takes. How many seconds can you last?

Good luck, mankind is counting on you.
